home.lead: Pick a product, pay, and a staff member releases the key. The bot stores it, grants the matching role, DMs the key to you and takes the role back when your time runs out.

why.title: Why buying here
why.lead: The store is the front door; Discord and the bot do the delivery.

delivery.title: Keys arrive as a Discord DM
delivery.body: One action stores the key, grants the product's role and DMs the key to the buyer — nobody copies keys between chats by hand.

duration.title: Access that ends on its own
duration.body: Every product carries a duration. When it expires the bot removes the role; buying again extends the time you already have instead of replacing it.

support.title: Support in the same place
support.body: Missing roles, wrong accounts and payment questions are handled in the Discord server — the same place your purchase lives.

faq.title: Questions we get asked
faq.lead: Straight answers about payment, delivery and durations.

items.a: A staff member verifies your payment and releases the key, usually inside support hours. The key then arrives in your Discord DM and the product's role is granted at the same moment.

items.q: Do I have to be in the Discord server?
items.a: Yes. The bot can only grant a role and send a key to a member of the server, so join with the Discord account you want the access on.
Open the order after checkout. It shows the QRIS code or the bank details and a field to upload your payment proof. Staff verify from there.

Check your Discord DMs first — Discord sometimes hides messages from bots in "Message requests". Then open the order page: if the status is still waiting, upload your payment proof; if it says delivered, ping staff in the server.

items.q: Can I use the access on another account?
items.a: No. The key is bound to the Discord account that bought it — the role and the expiry timer follow that account only.

items.q: The product stopped working, or I paid by mistake.
items.a: Say so in the Discord server within your active duration. Refunds are decided by staff case by case; the store itself never moves money back on its own.
